# A rope segment (generated by make_env.py): 14 m along +X from the origin, 0.08 m thick.
new
material new Rope --base-color 0.792 0.627 0.353 --no-slot
add mesh cube --name Rope --size 1 --location 7.000 0.000 0.000
scale 14.000 0.080 0.080
apply --scale
material assign Rope
select all
shade flat
export rope.glb
